name: Platonic Solid Projection
definition: A 3D space factorization method that projects 3D areas onto the faces of a Platonic solid, allowing anisotropic 3D areas to be represented on 2D planes with distinguishable characterization, reducing memory consumption from O(n^3) to O(n^2).
summary: Platonic Solid Projection factorizes 3D space onto Platonic solid faces, reducing memory and enabling flexible quality-efficiency trade-offs unlike cube-based tri-planes.
